title: Spacious 2-bedroom townhouse with rooftop
description:

Our townhome has everything needed to enjoy your stay in Nashville! In the kitchen, you'll find an interactive Samsung smart fridge and cookware. There's WiFi, Smart TVs and washer/dryer for your convenience and private rooftop for guests to relax and enjoy themselves!

Full access to the townhome with no shared spaces
